text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, a prioritized list of work. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe features from the customer's point of view. Every day, the team holds a short meeting called a standup to discuss progress and problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to release working products quickly, get feedback, and improve continuously.
